title: Nigeria Payment Service Providers
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for the current Central Bank of Nigeria payment-service-provider register snapshot, with optional code, website and logo enrichment. Each record represents one provider-category membership across the seven approved CBN PSP sections.
methodology: Independently compiled and cross-verified factual reference data from the public Central Bank of Nigeria PSP register. The register was retrieved three times with consistent results on 2026-08-29. Observed counts: mobile_money_operator 17; switching_and_processing_company 19; payment_solution_service_provider 108; payment_terminal_service_provider 47; super_agent 61; payment_service_holding_company 1; payment_terminal_service_aggregator 2. SoftData anchored extraction to the seven approved PSP sections and excluded card schemes, payment schemes, clearing-house content, IMTOs and adjacent page material. The CBN register is mutable; these counts describe the verified snapshot and do not establish a universal institution identifier. Former-name annotations were preserved in the working audit, then removed from the public display name only when clearly indicated. Optional enrichment is documented in payment_service_providers_reconciliation.json and uses the pinned community catalogue as the primary code/logo source. In that catalogue, bankCode represents the six-digit NIP institution-code field and scCode represents the three-digit legacy CBN/sort-code field. Most enrichment values are community-sourced; Paystack data is supporting evidence only, and mappings may require future confirmation against current CBN/NIBSS registers. Unresolved values are omitted rather than emitted as empty strings. Website research completed for all 255 records; 109 records have verified websites and 146 records currently lack websites.

sources.title: Payment Service Providers
sources.purpose: Verify the seven approved PSP sections, the current provider-category counts, and the public snapshot used for compilation.

enrichment.unresolved_identity_notes: Paystack Payment Limited and Xpress Payments Solution Limited remain identity conflicts for code/logo enrichment. Phase 2A reconciled 55 mobile-money archive assets, accepting three target assignments while preserving existing stronger assets; 36 source assets were rejected with explicit reasons.
